ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches are centered on both the left and right lobes, bordered by a dense black periphery. There is significant 'peppered' mottling (small black pixel clusters) within the white regions, particularly near the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 68 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge. The amplitude of these peaks is highest on the distal one-third of both lobes, appearing as sharp, jagged protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong upward and outward sweep; the trailing edge follows a complex convex curve from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear marks visible; one prominent diagonal rake mark across the right lobe white patch and several shorter, shallower horizontal abrasions on the left lobe patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notches and missing tissue segments along the trailing edge, particularly on the outer margin of the left lobe, indicating historic mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of spherical water droplets/spray across the foreground of the fluke, creating localized specular highlights.
